scenes.sub: When you LP you deposit both tokens and receive a share of the pool (a token, or an NFT for concentrated positions). You earn your share of swap fees. In return, your token mix changes as traders move the price: you become the counterparty
scenes.vo: When you L.P. you deposit both tokens and receive a share of the pool (a token, or an NFT for concentrated positions). You earn your share of swap fees. In return, your token mix changes as traders move the price: you become the counterparty to every trade. Fee A.P.R. estimate: fee A.P.R. about (daily volume times fee tier times your pool share times 365) divided by your deposit For a full-range pool your share equals deposit divided by pool T.V.L., so this simplifies to daily volume times fee tier times 365 divided by T.V.L. Use a 30-day average volume, not today's. Volume spikes on volatile days, which are also the days you take the most impermanent loss.
scenes.cap: When you LP you deposit both tokens and receive a share of the pool (a token, or an NFT for concentrated positions). You earn your share of swap fees. In return, your token mix changes as traders move the price: you become the counterparty to every trade. Fee APR estimate: fee APR ≈ (daily volume × fee tier × your pool share × 365) ÷ your deposit For a full-range pool your share = deposit ÷ pool TVL, so this simplifies to daily volume × fee tier × 365 ÷ TVL. Use a 30-day average volume, not today's. Volume spikes on volatile days, which are also the days you take the most impermanent loss.

scenes.title: Worked example: Pool TVL $10M, 30-day average daily volume $2M,…
steps: Your $10,000 = 0.1% share → $6/day → ~21.9% fee APR (before impermanent loss…
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. Pool T.V.L. $10M, 30-day average daily volume $2M, fee tier 0.3%: If volume halves, your fee A.P.R. halves. If a lot more T.V.L. joins the pool, your share shrinks. Daily pool fees equals 2,000,000 times 0.003 = $6,000. Your $10,000 equals 0.1% share to $6 a day to about 21.9% fee A.P.R. (before impermanent loss and gas).

scenes.q: Pool TVL $5M, daily volume $1M, 0.05% fee. Full-range fee APR?
scenes.vo: Question one. Pool T.V.L. $5M, daily volume $1M, 0.05% fee. Full-range fee A.P.R.? [[pause 4]] The answer: 1,000,000 times 0.0005 times 365 divided by 5,000,000 equals 3.65%.
scenes.cap: Question 1. Pool TVL $5M, daily volume $1M, 0.05% fee. Full-range fee APR? The answer: 1,000,000 × 0.0005 × 365 ÷ 5,000,000 = 3.65%.

scenes.a: Single-day spikes overstate fee income, and they happen on the days you take the most impermanent loss.
scenes.vo: Question two. Why use 30-day volume? [[pause 4]] The answer: Single-day spikes overstate fee income, and they happen on the days you take the most impermanent loss.
scenes.cap: Question 2. Why use 30-day volume? The answer: Single-day spikes overstate fee income, and they happen on the days you take the most impermanent loss.

scenes.q: What happens to your share if TVL doubles?
scenes.a: It halves, and so do your fees, at the same volume.
